verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Firstbase offers online incorporation. It references users who 'incorporate with Firstbase', a cap table created via Carta 'one click after incorporation', and an incorporation guide, and a community user reports getting a US company running in about 2 weeks (a Wyoming entity). It does not show the rest of the story end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit Delaware formation evidence, bylaws generation, initial board approvals/consents, a detailed description of the filing workflow, and independent corroboration of a Delaware end-to-end flow.
